I had the BLTB, which is your classic three-pronged sandwich along with Brie cheese. It was irresistible. We were there at the time of day when both breakfast and lunch were offered, so making a final decision on what to have was difficult, in a good way. Red Owl soars above in regard to food presentation and quality of taste. Owl surely be coming back sometime!
